basic_profile.bio: I'm a tech enthusiast from San Diego, California with a particular interest in building and tinkering with PCs. I enjoy diving into complex setups like dual-GPU systems for different operating systems. When I'm not immersed in tech, I like to explore the outdoors, especially the trails around Baja California. I work as a junior IT support specialist and often find myself online in the evenings after 6 PM PST. I'm currently single and spend my weekends either gaming or hiking.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong foundation in computer hardware, largely self-taught through years of building my own rigs and helping friends with their setups. I keep up-to-date with the latest tech news and trends through online forums and tech blogs.
